data.name: Asraht
data.gender_notes: Asraht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 's-r-h' meaning 'high, lofty, heavenly, throne'. This name is often used in reference to Allah's throne in the heavens. It is a name that evokes a sense of divine power, majesty, and protection. The name Asraht carries the meaning “Heavenly Throne” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Asraht usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly throne and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the connection between the believer and Allah, representing a deep sense of faith and devotion.
data.etymology: Asraht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavenly Throne.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asraht total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أسرة مشتق من الأصول العربية ويعني جمع الأسرة أو القبيلة، ويرتبط بالتواصل العائلي والاجتماعي. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق الحديث عن العائلة والمجتمع.

in_urdu.name: اسرہ
in_urdu.meaning: اسرہ کا مطلب ہے خاندان یا قبیلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسرہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے خاندان یا قبیلہ۔ یہ نام خاندانی اور سماجی روابط کی اہمیت پر زور دیتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، خاندان اور قبیلہ کے افراد کے درمیان روابط اور تعلقات بہت اہم ہیں.

in_hindi.name: आसरा
in_hindi.meaning: आसरा का अर्थ है परिवार या कबीला
in_hindi.long_meaning: आसरा नाम की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी भाषाओं में हुई है। यह नाम परिवार या कबीले को संदर्भित करता है, जो परिवार और समाज में मजबूत बंधन और संबंधों के महत्व पर बल देता है।

in_pashto.name: اسره
in_pashto.meaning: اسره د کورنۍ يا قوم معنی لري

This name is also associated with the concept of Allah's throne as the seat of His divine authority and justice.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Asraht" represents the idea of seeking refuge and solace in Allah's infinite and divine power. It highlights the importance of remembering Allah and seeking His protection from the trials and tribulations of life. The name also serves as a reminder of the ultimate reality of Allah's throne, and the impermanence and fleeting nature of our earthly existence.
